trace.label: findings about these stations and routes
trace.cypher:
MATCH (f:Finding)-[:ABOUT]->(n)
WHERE (n:Station AND n.id IN $stations) OR (n:Route AND n.id IN $routes)
WITH DISTINCT f
OPTIONAL MATCH (f)-[:FROM]->(i:Incident)
OPTIONAL MATCH (ag:Agent)-[:WROTE]->(f)

OPTIONAL MATCH (s)-[:TO]->(b:Station)

event.delta: Based on
the affected riders results, I am measuring network capacity and overflow to determine if spare
capacity can absorb displaced trips.

result.summary: 23,445 displaced riders an hour. If each takes the fastest open path, 4 segments overflow by 24,078 riders an hour: G Greenpoint Av → 21 St at 244%; G Nassau Av → Greenpoint Av at 201%; G 21 St → Court Sq-23 St at 198%; 4,689 have no open path. If riders are spread perfectly (max flow, forward peak direction), the open network can carry 17,167 of 18,432 (93%); 1,266 cannot move. Min cut is at the riders' own stations: 1 Av (1,266) have no open alternative.
